title: Oozer

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Oozers are aggressive creatures found in Swamps. They are large, gelatinous piles of sentient ooze that emit poisonous yellow gasses. Upon death, they split into two Blobs.

table_data.Type: Anywhere in Swamp during the nighttime, despawn at dawn
Rare spawn point in front of Sunken Crypts, doesn't despawn at dawn
During "A foul smell from the swamp" event after defeating Bonemass
When a Blob bomb Elite poison is used

sections.heading: Area of effect
sections.text: Oozers will stretch slightly before compressing and releasing a cloud of poisonous gas 8 meters in radius, applying the Poison status (115 Poison damage). Despite visual appearances, the cloud does not actually persist and only hits once. This ability can be used when a player is within 3 meters, and it has a cooldown of 4 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Oozers have a chance to drop Scrap iron, meaning they can theoretically provide early access to Iron equipment before the player obtains a Swamp key. However, given the relatively uncommon spawn rate for Oozers, low drop rate of Scrap iron, and high metal cost of iron equipment, this is generally not a viable strategy for obtaining Iron.
• Oozers have no associated trophy.

Introduction. Oozers are aggressive creatures found in Swamps. They are large, gelatinous piles of sentient ooze that emit poisonous yellow gasses. Upon death, they split into two Blobs.

Area of effect. Oozers will stretch slightly before compressing and releasing a cloud of poisonous gas 8 meters in radius, applying the Poison status (115 Poison damage). Despite visual appearances, the cloud does not actually persist and only hits once. This ability can be used when a player is within 3 meters, and it has a cooldown of 4 seconds.

Notes. • Oozers have a chance to drop Scrap iron, meaning they can theoretically provide early access to Iron equipment before the player obtains a Swamp key. However, given the relatively uncommon spawn rate for Oozers, low drop rate of Scrap iron, and high metal cost of iron equipment, this is generally not a viable strategy for obtaining Iron.
• Oozers have no associated trophy.
